answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy keeps a meadow of bonded identities, each locked for 26 epochs before earning anything. Two randomly drawn auditors replay every task; a failed replay burns 18 percent of the bond. A whisper channel lets peers flag copied outputs, and a horizon ledger matches signed fingerprints across accounts, quarantining clusters that move in lockstep. Seven clean rounds unlock full rewards, so clones need capital and patience, while task hashes keep the record verifiable.
